verdict.rationale: The product ships extensive SKILL.md files (e.g. tdd, triage, grilling) that are explicitly agent-oriented documentation meant to be read directly by coding agents, and works across multiple agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Copilot). However there is no evidence of an actual llms.txt for this product — the only llms.txt probe hit is GitHub's own generic file, and a probe for the project's docs.md returned 404, so the 'point an agent at llms.txt' half of the story is unconfirmed. Missing for 10: a dedicated llms.txt manifest for the skills repo, and independent confirmation an agent can be pointed at it and successfully ingest it.
